limits: Waveform correlation is not visual lip sync.
Auditory emphasis is inherited from the locked WAV; gentler facial emphasis needs moving review.
Wider framing reduces apparent mouth size; raw mouth pixel sizes must not be compared to M.
No canonical production approval or gate changes.

head_motion.method: Existing native Vision face landmarks on 12 sampled frames per clip; 2D eye midpoint and eye-line angle, normalized by median eye separation; not 3D head pose or dense motion tracking
head_motion.times_are: Same 12 local video frames as earlier K/F comparison; all three audio delays independently measured +23.020833 ms
limits: Landmark movement includes estimation noise and face perspective; confidence is not an accuracy bound
Eye-line angle measures in-plane roll, not pitch/yaw
Raw mouth-pixel size is not comparable across differently framed faces
Word-level times do not establish exact phoneme closures

visual_review.hand_motion: Actual right forearm/open-hand gesture is visible on viewer left: rises near 0.75–1.00 s, changes position through the first sentence, rises again near 4.00 s. The other hand rests on the desk. This is not merely newly visible static hands.
visual_review.sampled_anatomy: Both wrists remain connected and the resting hand is consistent. No unmistakable extra digit, extra limb or grossly fused hand is visible. Moving fingers overlap/soften, particularly near 1.00 s, so exact individual-digit anatomy is uncertain.
visual_review.review_basis: Agent and independent child agent inspected full-frame and hand-detail contact sheets.
visual_review.head_comparison: Sampled normalized eye-center displacement is about 65 percent higher than accepted M; sampled roll range is similar. Wider framing can make movement seem smaller. Metrics are sparse 2D landmarks, not 3D motion or a quality verdict.
visual_review.mouth_emphasis: Mouth shapes change during speech. Eight sampled images do not establish that visual stress on straight is softer than M; the locked narration preserves its audible stress. Owner moving review is decisive for preference.
visual_review.baseline: M remains the owner-accepted baseline; O is a candidate awaiting owner review.

hands_contact_binding.display_scaling: Each hand crop scaled from 1120x430 to 560x215; RGB otherwise unchanged.
